name: Fractalize — target creature becomes a green and blue Fractal with base power and toughness X plus 1
notes: Sweep group 2 (2026-10-07). "with base power and toughness each equal to 3 plus 1" (X filled in) hit the set-type skip words and the whole sentence was dropped. That clause is now read as a base P/T. X = 3: Grizzly Bears is a 4/4 green and blue Fractal.
